previous_value.description: No-change: predict current log_market_value as next

mae_log.note: Lower is better; MAE in log-space captures relative error

median_absolute_percentage_error.note: Lower is better; robust to outliers

mae_eur_millions.note: Distorted by outlier valuations; not primary metric

rationale: Best MAE in log-space (0.205) — most reliable metric
Best median absolute percentage error (13.4%) — robust to outliers
Interpretable: predicts change relative to current value
Aligns model objective with strongest baseline (no-change at residual=0)
Better generalization than direct MLP through residual formulation
alternative_rationale: Slightly lower MAE_log (0.209 vs 0.205) but within noise
Feature importance (SHAP) interpretability for regulatory compliance
not_recommended: mlp_numeric_direct: Underperforms all metrics except EUR scale
previous_value: Use as monitoring baseline only

validation_set_metrics.note: Validation results shown for reference; similar to test indicates good generalization

inference_pipeline.step_6: Return prediction ± uncertainty interval (optional Bayesian dropout)

methodology_notes.temporal_causality: Strictly historical; all features computed with game_date < valuation_date

residual_learning.purpose: Frame problem as competitive with no-change baseline; focus capacity on predictable changes

feature_categories: Player profile (age, position, foot, height, contract)
Performance windows (90/180/365 days: appearances, minutes, goals, assists, ratios)
Club context (squad size, average age, stadium, transfers)

limitations.data_source: Transfermarkt valuations are estimates, not real transfer prices
limitations.geographic_bias: Top-5 European leagues well-covered; others sparse
limitations.performance_gaps: No advanced stats (xG, xA); no injury/suspension flags
limitations.categorical_encoding: One-hot encoding used; player/club/position embeddings would be more efficient
limitations.club_features: Snapshots at valuation date, not rolling windows
limitations.player_heterogeneity: No separate models per position; may underperform for specific roles
